description: Behavioural evaluation set for the award-design skill. Cases pin the universe-mandatory contract: conceive a committed anti-default universe, write it as a DESIGN.md (or adapt to and alert on a thin existing one), commit-and-prove before any JSX, and let /design-system govern the file after. Plus archetype + stack routing, review-mode audit, scope discipline (dashboards out, single-token tweaks to design-system), and the WebGL one-subagent carve-out.

evals.name: universe-mandatory-build-writes-design-md
evals.prompt: Build me a beautiful brutalist developer-tools landing page. Black-and-white, monospace, raw. Make it fast — I want to see the site, not a spec.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to ship pixels without a committed universe — the universe is mandatory, never optional. Conceives it first: a one-line Design Read, a Concept Spine naming one world (not a literal 'a dev-tools page' restatement), anti-default-with-teeth (names the lazy brutalist default and rejects it, rotates off prior builds, invents ≥1 fresh mechanic), and a signature moment with the removing-every-effect falsifiable test. Writes a complete DESIGN.md (Google format) as the committed direction — no inline-token-block shortcut, no opt-in Persist. Then emits a binding design_plan with explicit per-element commitments (hero, type stack, color roles, motion, the signature beat) each paired with a proof line (the clamp()/max-w guaranteeing the H1 lands in ≤2 lines, the named real hero asset) BEFORE any JSX, and builds under it claimed = shown. Resists the 'make it fast' primer: 'fast' scopes to writing the universe quickly, never to skipping it or the craft — full-effort, signature landed, ≥3 axes pushed past the generic SaaS template. A correct-but-generic page does NOT satisfy this case.

evals.name: adapts-to-existing-design-md-alerts-if-thin
evals.prompt: Add a pricing page to my site. There's already a DESIGN.md at the root.
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing DESIGN.md and adopts it as the ultimate reference — skips archetype selection, builds the pricing page consistent with its tokens, re-reading it every pass rather than re-authoring. Alerts when that DESIGN.md is thin or incomplete (missing a real spacing scale, type ramp, motion language, or signature choreography) instead of silently re-authoring it, and proposes filling the gaps. Routes a pure single-token tweak (one color, one radius) to `/design-system`, which governs the file after the build.

evals.name: motion-3d-archetype-picks-tanstack-and-webgl-subagent
evals.prompt: Cinematic, scroll-driven launch site for a hardware product — full-screen 3D hero, the model assembles as you scroll. Award-worthy.
evals.expected_output: Reads this as an Immersive / Cinematic brief and commits a universe whose signature is the scroll-driven 3D assembly, written into the DESIGN.md with the scroll choreography and easing lexicon. Keys the framework to the archetype: TanStack Start (React on Vite + Nitro) on the motion/3D path, not Astro — with the locked universal craft (GSAP + Lenis + CSS scroll-driven + View Transitions + variable fonts + OKLCH) and Motion/Framer + R3F on the TanStack path only. Delegates exactly ONE subagent to author the self-contained WebGL/R3F scene module (clean component boundary, props in / canvas out), handing it the DESIGN.md as its brief and pointing it at `references/ingredients/web3d-for-sites.md`, then integrates the returned module itself — never co-writing a shared file, never more than one parallel writer.

evals.name: review-mode-audits-existing-site-refute-by-default
evals.prompt: award-design review https://example-saas.com — is this award-ready?
evals.expected_output: Runs review mode against the awwwards rubric (`references/audit-rubric.md`), the anti-slop catalog (`references/anti-patterns.md`), and the DESIGN.md if one exists. Refutes by default — treats 'this is on track' as unproven and hunts where the site reads generic, safe, or off-universe (AI-purple gradients, Inter/Roboto on the display face, the centered-hero-over-dark template, 3 equal feature cards, a hero with no real visual, meta-labels). Reports on-track / off-track with concrete, cited fixes; never a silent pass.

evals.name: selects-corporate-luxury-for-premium-advisory
evals.prompt: I'm building a website for a high-end financial advisory firm. Wealth management, ultra-high-net-worth clients. They need to feel established and trustworthy.
evals.expected_output: Reads this as a Corporate Luxury brief (high-end, established, trustworthy → low Variance, low Motion, generous whitespace), matching the archetype to the brand's personality, not a trend. Calibrates atmosphere on the Density / Variance / Motion dials per `references/atmosphere-calibration.md`, then conceives and writes a committed anti-default universe as a DESIGN.md — rotating past the overexposed sand/brass/espresso premium-consumer palette rather than defaulting to it. Keys the framework to Astro (content/perf archetype). Builds under the universe with a signature moment, not a generic luxury template.

evals.name: redirects-dashboard-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: Design our internal admin dashboard for the customer-success team. Lots of tables and metrics.
evals.expected_output: Declines — this skill is frontend-design for award-grade public sites, not internal tooling; the description explicitly excludes dashboards and internal tools. Does not conceive a universe or author a DESIGN.md. Redirects to a pragmatic data-density approach (or a general-purpose implementation path) rather than invoking the archetype + universe forcing.

evals.name: uses-brand-extraction-for-existing-url-redesign
evals.prompt: Redesign coroboros.com — keep the spirit, refresh the execution.
evals.expected_output: Reverse-engineers the brand first via `references/brand-extraction.md` — observes the live site, drafts atmosphere observations, then proposes an archetype and a committed universe consistent with the existing brand, written as a DESIGN.md. Does not propose a wholesale archetype shift unless the brief asks for one; routes a legacy-site uplift through `references/retrofit.md` rather than a from-scratch rebuild.
